title: Archive legacy flag state and unify runtime versioning
creator: Ariana Soto
description:
Background: Over the last three years we accumulated multiple flag-storage and rollout-path code paths: legacy admin endpoints (admin/v0), the compatibility 'rollout-shim' that rewrites older rollout graphs, and a shadowed flag ledger (flags_ledger_v1) used only by Dedicated migrations. These parallel surfaces increase maintenance cost, cause intermittent mismatches during canaries, and complicate the runtime's config-selection logic (we currently have three places the runtime consults to pick a versioned config).

Goal: Consolidate runtime config versioning onto a single canonical index (config-index-v2), archive the old flag ledger and admin/v0 endpoints, and remove the rollout-shim adapter. The end state should be: runtime consults config-index-v2 only; historical flag state is archived and queryable for audits; and the system has a short compatibility adapter run window before full removal.

Scope & deliverables:
- Build a one-time archival job (tools/flag-archiver) that exports flags_ledger_v1 -> s3://redwood-archives/flags/2026-q1 with retention metadata.
- Migrate active flag state into config-index-v2 and run a reconciliation job to ensure parity (acceptance tolerance: < 0.01% mismatch).
- Add a lightweight compatibility adapter (runtime toggle behind feature flag) that rewrites admin/v0 requests to the new API for a 2-week observation window; this adapter is timeboxed and instrumented heavily.
- Deprecate and remove admin/v0 routes from the admin service; remove rollout-shim microservice and its tests after the adapter window.
- Update docs and console UI pointers to the unified config index and versioning docs.

Testing & rollout plan:
1) Local dry-run + unit tests for migrator and reconcilers.
2) Staging full migration with synthetic traffic; run reconciliation and smoke tests.
3) Canary rollout to 10% of host traffic with compatibility adapter enabled; monitor parity dashboards and error rates for 48h.
4) If stable, increase to 100% and schedule adapter TTL to expire after 14 days.
5) After TTL, remove adapter and delete admin/v0 routes + shim code in a follow-up PR.

Observability & acceptance criteria:
- Reconciliation mismatch <= 0.01% after migration.
- No more than 0.05% increase in 5xxs or rollout failures during canary.
- Dashboards: rollout-compat-heartbeat, config-reconcile, admin-api-5xx. Links in attachments.

Rollback plan:
- Re-enable rollout-shim via infra toggle (infra/rollout-router-toggle) and restore flags_ledger_v1 from S3 snapshot to a hot path if reconciliation shows unacceptable divergence.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Hidden consumers calling admin/v0 directly. Mitigation: Add telemetry to identify callers before adapter removal; send targeted owner alerts.
- Risk: Reconciliation edge cases for very old experiments. Mitigation: Archive historical entries but keep read-only query interface for audit team for 180 days.

Docs & artifacts:
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Archive+legacy+flag+state+and+unify+versioning
- Migration tooling: github.com/redwood-inference/tools/tree/main/flag-archiver (PR linked below)
- Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/rollout-compat-heartbeat

Acceptance criteria for Done:
- Archival job runs successfully and files land in S3 with expected metadata + checksum.
- Reconciliation job reports < 0.01% mismatch and all mismatches are triaged.
- Compatibility adapter exercised for 14 days with stable metrics.
- admin/v0 endpoints removed and code coverage for v1 paths added.
- Confluence and Console docs updated and reviewed by PM/Design.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Ariana Soto: Initial triage and scoping. Hitlist of code paths and owners collected (admin-service, rollout-router, dedicated-migrations). Raising P1 due to operational overhead and recurring incidents during rollouts.

2026-03-11 - Liam Chen: Engineering design review notes — suggested adding a reconciliation dry-run mode to produce per-flag diff reports and sample keys for manual inspection. Also flagged potential S3 throughput limits for bulk archivals; recommended batching by namespace.

2026-03-11 - Review (PM: Mateo Alvarez): Confirmed schedule constraints; PM requested a notice to customers using Dedicated within 2 weeks prior to admin/v0 removal. Added 'customer-communication' label to follow-up tasks.

2026-03-12 - Infra (Riya Patel): Requested infra toggle pattern for adapter with actor-level audit logs; will provision toggle and 1-week TTL enforcement policy. Also opened infra ticket INFRA-1882 for rate-limiting fallback during reconciliation.

2026-03-12 - Liam Chen: Drafted PR for flag-archiver (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4721) and reconciliation job (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4723). Marked for internal review; QA planned on 2026-03-18.
